cases: Health probe requires JSON ok:true and rejects failures, redirects, invalid JSON, oversized responses and timeouts

launcherIntegration.isolation: Temporary synthetic desktop config, temporary SQLite, temporary Vite caches and dynamically reserved loopback ports. Fixed-port existing development services were not stopped, reused or modified.

limits: No public-facing port, production service, nginx configuration or account API contract was changed.
No new browser, physical-device or production acceptance was performed; new integration coverage uses real HTTP and Vite with synthetic data.
Prior three/four-service evidence and initial maintenance receipts were preserved.
